events.subtitle: Super Button Masher Album Release Show
events.factual_description: Blue Note New York presents Button Masher: Super Button Masher Album Release Show on Tuesday, September 8, 2026, with sets at 8:00 PM and 10:30 PM; doors are at 6:00 PM and 10:00 PM respectively. The venue identifies Button Masher as Jake Silverman, a GRAMMY-winning arranger, electronic musician, composer and educator whose project has combined jazz fusion with chiptune since 2018. Brainfeeder/Ninja Tune released Super Button Masher on September 4, 2026 and describes the album as cross-genre compositions that merge sophisticated harmonies with reconstructed 8-bit and 16-bit soundscapes. Blue Note lists a $20 per-person food-and-beverage minimum, which is not treated as a ticket face value. The venue exposes separate authorized TicketWeb purchase links for the two sets rather than one engagement-wide ticket destination.

en.why_it_matters: Four days after Super Button Masher arrived on Brainfeeder, Silverman brings its jazz-fusion/chiptune language into Blue Note: not video-game nostalgia as a novelty, but 8-bit and 16-bit timbres used as compositional material inside harmonically dense electronic writing. The collision of arranging craft, synthetic texture and an actual album-release night gives this specific performance a reason to exist on RADAR beyond the room or the genre label.
en.trip_verdict: If you are already in New York today, choose one of the two sets and build the evening around the Village club. From the DMV, I would not make a same-day dedicated trip solely for this show; the recommendation is strongest inside an existing New York day rather than as a last-minute corridor run.

es.why_it_matters: Cuatro días después de que Super Button Masher saliera en Brainfeeder, Silverman lleva a Blue Note ese lenguaje de jazz fusion y chiptune: no la nostalgia de los videojuegos como truco, sino timbres de 8 y 16 bits usados como material compositivo dentro de una escritura electrónica armónicamente densa. El cruce entre oficio de arreglo, textura sintética y una verdadera noche de lanzamiento le da a esta función una razón concreta para estar en RADAR más allá del prestigio del lugar o de la etiqueta de género.
es.trip_verdict: Si ya estás en Nueva York hoy, escogería uno de los dos sets y armaría la noche alrededor del club en Greenwich Village. Desde el DMV no haría un viaje dedicado de último minuto sólo por esta función; la recomendación es mucho más fuerte dentro de un día que ya estuviera planteado en Nueva York que como una corrida improvisada por el corredor.
